The tolerance we seek must be reflected in every aspect of daily life, at school, on the street, in stadiums, on beaches and at swimming pools, at airports and online. Countering hatred requires courage in public discourse, fairness in policy, and sustained efforts to address the causes of marginalization and restore trust between individuals, their communities, and their institutions. Morocco's organization of this conference is a natural expression of its steadfast commitment to dialogue, tolerance, and coexistence. The coexistence of different religious communities, Muslims, Jews, and Christians sharing the same living space over the centuries subsequently became an institutional choice reflected in state policies under the leadership of His Majesty King Mohammed VI. Under the aegis of the same institution and in keeping with these national foundations, Morocco plays a leading role in advancing efforts to counter hate speech in international fora. Our responsibility, as we gather at this conference, is to ensure that mutual respect makes a tangible difference in people's lives and that preventing hatred remains a permanent part of our collective work.
